metadata.title: my-agents
metadata.description: Frontend console for private chats and shared knowledge bases

home.eyebrow: AI product console with run evidence
home.title: A console for transcripts, evidence, and source-aware conversations.
home.description: From one authenticated workspace, inspect transcript flows, stream activity events, validate citations, and trace every answer to its source documents.
featureCards: Transcript-first workflow: user turns and assistant responses remain linked per conversation.
Activity timeline for run lifecycle events, queued follow-ups, and stop operations.
Citation-backed cards make provenance explicit for each knowledge-assisted response.
transcriptRows: user: Can you summarize today’s conversation highlights?
agent: Captured 3 evidence snippets from the knowledge index.
system: Citation batch attached; document source: docs/onboarding.md
activityItems: Run started: assistant invoked with knowledge tools
Citation attached from document source: docs/onboarding.md
Queued follow-up accepted after current answer
home.citationText: Every visible answer includes source-backed references before rendering in the chat pane.
home.sourceText: Primary artifacts: PDF, Markdown, and plain-text sources captured with chunk metadata.

auth.heroDescription: Sign in, then inspect transcript turns, activity events, citations, and document-source evidence in one console flow.
features: Keep conversation transcripts linked to citation-backed agent activity.
Track live run lifecycle and queued follow-ups from the same shell.
Open document-source evidence from each assistant response.
auth.signupDescription: Create an account, then log in with the same credentials.
auth.loginDescription: Use your service session to enter the console.
auth.signupSuccessDescription: We created {email}. You can now log in with this account.
auth.guestDescription: Enter an email to request a one-time guest code. Guest sessions last 24 hours and are limited to one chat, up to 5 prompts, and up to 3 document uploads.
auth.guestEmailHint: If approved, the operator will send a guest access code to this address.
auth.guestRequestReceivedDescription: If {email} is eligible, the operator will send a guest code to that inbox. Until email automation is wired, this may be a manual step.
auth.guestCodeDescription: Redeem the code from your email to start the limited demo session.
auth.guestCodeHint: Codes are one-time use and expire automatically.

service.sessionRestored: Session restored. Chat, documents, knowledge, and group actions are ready.
sessionEvidenceItems: Conversation runs expose status, activity events, and citations.
Documents keep source metadata visible for upload and ingest checks.
ID-based group workflows remain explicit until member search exists.

chat.title: Chat
chat.description: Private assistant chat with selectable knowledge sources.
chat.deleteConversationConfirm: Delete "{title}"? This removes the conversation and all messages. This cannot be undone.
chat.deleteConversationActiveRunDisabled: Stop the active answer before deleting this conversation.
chat.noActiveConversationDescription: Create a conversation to unlock the chat composer.
chat.streamingComposerPlaceholder: Type a follow-up — Enter queues it after this answer.
chat.queuedComposerPlaceholder: Edit or cancel the queued message before adding another follow-up.
chat.sendNowHelper: Enter queues your follow-up. Send now stops the current answer first, then sends this message.
chat.sendNowWaitingForRun: Waiting for the active answer before it can be stopped.
chat.sendNowQueuedBlocked: Edit or cancel the queued message before sending a different message now.
chat.queuedHelper: Will send after the current answer finishes.
chat.queuedAfterFailureHelper: The current answer failed. Send this queued message manually, edit it, or cancel it.
chat.guestPromptLimitHelper: Guest demo limits are enforced automatically; queued and immediate messages still count when accepted.
chat.queuedAnnouncement: Message queued to send after the current answer.
chat.queueEditAnnouncement: Queued message moved back to the composer.
chat.queueAlreadyExistsAnnouncement: A queued message already exists. Edit or cancel it first.
chat.stoppingCurrentAnswerAnnouncement: Stopping the current answer before sending your message.
chat.currentAnswerStoppingAnnouncement: Stop request accepted. Waiting for the current answer to close.
chat.immediateFailedAnnouncement: Could not stop the current answer. Your message was restored to the composer.
chat.noRunsDescription: Send a message to create the first run.
chat.noEventsDescription: Latest run events will appear here.
chat.noCitationsDescription: RAG citations appear when retrieved context is used.
chat.messageEvidenceUnavailable: Run evidence is attached to the latest assistant answer.
chat.guestNoticeDescription: This guest session lasts 24 hours and is limited to one chat, 5 prompts, and 3 document uploads. If you hit a limit, a safe error appears here.
chat.knowledgeSourceDescription: Use personal knowledge by default. Add group knowledge only when this question needs shared context.
chat.noKnowledgeBasesDescription: Create a knowledge base, add documents, then select it here.
chat.knowledgeSourceRequired: Select at least one knowledge base or switch back to All knowledge bases.
chat.replaySuccess: Regenerated. The conversation was refreshed with the replay result.
chat.replaySourcesUnavailable: Regenerated using current knowledge only. Some sources from the original answer are no longer available.
chat.replaySourcesUnavailableAnnouncement: Assistant message regenerated with unavailable original sources omitted.
chat.replayFailed: Could not regenerate this assistant message.
chat.replayConflict: Only the latest assistant message can be regenerated right now.
chat.replayConflictAnnouncement: This assistant message cannot be regenerated because it is not the latest replayable answer.
chat.personalChatBoundaryCopy: This stays a private user-to-assistant conversation. Choose the personal knowledge bases the assistant may reference.
chat.groupChatBoundaryCopy: Group knowledge is an optional source for this answer; the conversation itself stays private.
chat.groupKnowledgeSourceDescription: Keep the chat private, and include knowledge shared with a group when needed.
chat.groupContextRequired: Select at least one group to include shared knowledge.
chat.noGroupKnowledgeBases: No shared knowledge bases for the selected groups yet
chat.optionalPrivateKnowledgeDescription: Optional personal sources stay private and apply only to this answer.
chat.groupChatOpenApiPending: Only this answer uses the selected group and personal sources.
chat.groupChatSendDisabled: Choose at least one group before including group knowledge.
chat.groupChatPendingAnnouncement: Choose one or more groups to include shared knowledge in this private chat.
chat.groupChatCreateDisabled: Choose at least one group before including group knowledge.

common.emptyListDescription: Create one from the form above.

knowledge.title: Knowledge bases
knowledge.description: Create places where documents can be stored and searched. Private knowledge bases are only for you; group knowledge bases are available to members after sharing is approved.
knowledge.scopeHint: Private knowledge bases stay private to your account. Group knowledge bases are shared libraries for selected groups; add private material through owner/admin-approved share requests.
knowledge.groupHint: Required for extra group knowledge bases. Only groups where you are owner/admin are listed.
knowledge.groupDisabledHint: Choose group scope to select an existing group.
knowledge.noGroupsDescription: Create a group or ask a group owner/admin before creating another group knowledge base.
knowledge.scopeBoundaryNote: New groups automatically get one default group knowledge base. Upload documents to private knowledge bases first; sharing with a group requires owner/admin approval and does not share member conversations, transcripts, or private additions.
knowledge.listPersonalSubtitle: Private knowledge base · private to your account
knowledge.listGroupSubtitle: Group knowledge base · available to selected group members

documents.title: Documents
documents.description: Upload and organize documents inside a private knowledge base. When you want a group to use a document, share its knowledge base from the Groups page.
documents.contentHint: Content is stored for search after ingestion creates searchable chunks and entities.
documents.permissionLabel: Grant read permission to user id
documents.permissionHint: Advanced control: paste a user ID to grant direct read access. User search can be added later.
documents.pdfUploadHint: Upload a PDF, Markdown (.md/.markdown), or plain text (.txt) file into the selected private knowledge base. CSV/JSON are not shown until structured-file support is available.
documents.deleteDescription: Remove the selected uploaded or text document when ingestion produced bad data. This cannot be undone.
documents.fileUploadHint: Upload a PDF, Markdown (.md/.markdown), or plain text (.txt) file into the selected private knowledge base. CSV/JSON are not shown until structured-file support is available.
documents.multiFileUploadHint: Select one or more PDF, Markdown (.md/.markdown), or plain text (.txt) files. Each file is limited to {maxSize}.
documents.dropTitle: Drag files here or choose files below
documents.dropActiveTitle: Drop files to add them to the queue
documents.dropDescription: Dropped files are validated locally, added to the queue, then uploaded and ingested when you start processing.
documents.unsupportedFileError: Unsupported file type. Choose PDF, Markdown, or plain text.
documents.fileTooLargeError: File is too large. Maximum size is {maxSize}.
documents.filesAddedAnnouncement: {count} files added to the upload queue.
documents.uploadRemovedAnnouncement: File removed from the upload queue.
documents.guestUploadLimitHint: Guest demo uploads are limited automatically; each accepted file counts toward the 3-document upload cap.
documents.knowledgeBaseHint: Create a private knowledge base first. New text documents, file uploads, and ingestion runs stay private until you request sharing with a group.
documents.knowledgeBaseRequired: Select a personal knowledge base before adding or ingesting documents.
documents.noKnowledgeBaseDescription: Go to Knowledge and create a private knowledge base before uploading documents. Group knowledge bases receive documents only through approved share requests.
documents.knowledgeBaseLockedHint: Finish or remove queued uploads before switching personal knowledge bases so each file stays attached to the intended private library.

groups.title: Groups
groups.description: Groups are shared spaces for knowledge bases. Add members, choose who can manage the group, and review requests to share private knowledge with the group.
groups.noSelectedDescription: Create or select a group first.
groups.membershipManagerOnlyHint: Only group owners and admins can add members or change roles.
groups.publishBoundaryDescription: Members can ask to share a private knowledge base with this group, or copy one document into a group knowledge base. Owners and admins approve what becomes available as group knowledge.
groups.publishSourceDocumentHint: Use this to copy one document into a selected group knowledge base.
groups.publishTargetKnowledgeBaseHint: Only document-copy requests need a target group knowledge base. Whole knowledge-base requests attach to the group itself.
groups.publishReviewHint: Owner/admin-only approval or rejection; no auto-publish.
groups.publishOpenApiNote: Share requests support both whole private knowledge-base approval and single-document copy approval. Pending or rejected requests do not change group knowledge.
groups.publishSourceKnowledgeBaseHint: Approval shares this whole private knowledge base with the group. Future documents added and ingested there become group sources.
groups.memberIdNote: For now, add or update members by user ID. User search can be added later.

errors.csrfMissing: Session proof is missing. Please sign in again.
errors.legacyChatBlocked: Legacy assistant chat is not available in the product
